title: Hand tool pan jumps the camera when a second finger starts a pinch
reason: Describes a one-frame jump when a second touch changes an active hand-tool pan into a pinch before the pinch state is set. This is a concrete pointer-state race, but the report has no comments.

varveAssessment.assessment: A useful mobile interaction lead; no Varve reproduction was performed and no change should be inferred from upstream behavior alone.

title: Rewrite dotcom E2E tests around scenario fixtures
reason: Proposes replacing upstream dotcom smoke tests and destructive resets with isolated multi-user scenario fixtures. This is a test-architecture proposal for a service Varve does not ship.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's own E2E architecture is unrelated to upstream dotcom collaboration fixtures; no local change is indicated.

title: Design-system consistency in the dotcom client
reason: Umbrella cleanup for the tldraw.com client to use shared components, tokens, and CSS conventions. The comment acknowledges the review; child tasks are tracked separately.

varveAssessment.assessment: This concerns upstream dotcom, not the Varve marketing site. No local feature work was derived from it.

title: Replace raw <button> elements with TlaButton in the dotcom client
reason: Child of #9189. Comments show the original file list became stale, with a contributor identifying completed, intentionally raw, and remaining buttons; subsequent proposed work did not establish a merged resolution.

varveAssessment.assessment: TlaButton is an upstream dotcom component; no claim is made about Varve site buttons.

title: Replace raw form inputs with shared input components in the dotcom client
reason: Child of #9189. Discussion scopes the specialized shared input component's limitations and clarifies optional admin-search cleanup; contributor offers and assignment coordination do not demonstrate a merged fix.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is upstream client cleanup and does not establish a defect in the separate Astro marketing site.

reason: Child task proposes deleting upstream CSS that duplicates TlaButton variants after markup migration. No comments were available.

reason: Notes that upstream dotcom has typography utility classes but no text tokens/component, and asks whether the system should influence editor packages. The comment requests discussion rather than documenting an accepted direction.

varveAssessment.assessment: The issue does not audit Varve's Astro design system and records no decision that can be transplanted.

title: Resolve off-scale spacing values (6/10/24px) in the dotcom client
reason: Explains that mechanical token migration shipped upstream and the remaining 6, 10, and 24px values require a design-scale decision. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Do not import upstream spacing values without a Varve design review; no marketing-site edit is indicated by this report.
